svg.aria-label: SQL versus NoSQL: relational databases store normalized tables with joins and transactions; NoSQL families include key-value, document, wide-column and graph stores, each built around a specific access pattern and easier horizontal scaling.
svg.title: SQL versus NoSQL: relational databases store normalized tables with joins and transactions; NoSQL families include key-value, document, wide-column and graph stores, each built around a specific access pattern and easier horizontal scaling.
svg.text: pick by access pattern: known keys, huge write volume
